description: This file defines a Java interface named LogNode, which specifies a logging component with a method to output log data, supporting chaining and customizable logging targets.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system that can output logs to one or more targets, supporting chaining and data manipulation.

methods.name: println
methods.description: A method to instruct the first LogNode in the chain to print the provided log data, supporting log level, tag, message, and optional exception.
